SELECT user_no AS userNo, role, userId, userPwd, addr, name, phone, phone_verified, email, email_verified, email_verify_token, email_verify_expired_at, birth, gender, photo, last_login_at, created_date, updated_date, is_blocked, block_reason, blocked_at FROM USERS WHERE userId = #{providerUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( user_no, role, userId, userPwd, addr, name, phone, phone_verified, email, email_verified, email_verify_token, email_verify_expired_at, birth, gender, photo, last_login_at, created_date, updated_date, is_blocked, block_reason, blocked_at ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{role}, #{userId}, #{userPwd}, #{addr}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{phoneVerified}, #{email}, #{emailVerified}, #{emailVerifyToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{emailVerifyExpiredAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{photo}, #{lastLoginAt}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{isBlocked}, #{blockReason}, #{blockedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_no AS userNo, role, userId, userPwd, addr, name, phone, phone_verified, email, email_verified, email_verify_token, email_verify_expired_at, birth, gender, photo, last_login_at, created_date, updated_date, is_blocked, block_reason, blocked_at FROM USERS WHERE email_verify_token = #{token}

SELECT user_no AS userNo, role, userId, userPwd, addr, name, phone, phone_verified AS phoneVerified, email, email_verified AS emailVerified, email_verify_token AS emailVerifyToken, email_verify_expired_at AS emailVerifyExpiredAt, birth, gender, photo, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate, is_blocked AS isBlocked, block_reason AS blockReason, blocked_at AS blockedAt FROM USERS WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET is_blocked = #{blocked}, block_reason = #{blockReason}, blocked_at = CASE WHEN #{blocked} = 'Y' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END WHERE user_no = #{userNo}

UPDATE USERS SET userPwd = #{userPwd}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.role AS role, u.userId AS userId, u.name AS name, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.addr AS addr, TO_CHAR(u.birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, u.gender AS gender, u.photo AS photo, TO_CHAR(u.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdDate, TO_CHAR(u.last_login_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS lastLoginAt FROM USERS u WHERE u.userId = #{userId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE USERS
name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, addr = #{addr},
birth = TO_DATE(#{birth}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
gender = #{gender},
photo = #{photo},
updated_date = SYSDATE
WHERE userId = #{userId}
